notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.14
notes.content:
Welcome back everyone, today we have another Decktamer update for you, fresh out of the oven!

[h1]Reworked UI[/h1]

We have reworked the encounter choice menu in order to make it more intuitive and to give it a little boost in terms of visuals. Some players didn't even notice that you could select which encounter to choose with the little arrows, so we also added an explanation for that ingame. 
Quite a big improvement compared to the old menu, isn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/ab5ed1701e95bb086d34de43818acc4ee7f5eb67.png[/img]
[i]Old Menu[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/c14e82df850bc1b7e849eb5af6a993a9a9baaf98.png[/img]
[i]New Menu[/i]

[h1]Polish & Visual Enhancements[/h1]
We've also added a bunch of enhancements to make the game feel better across the board:
[list]
[*] Screen Shake
[*] VFX: A lot of visual effects have been added to various attacks and talents.
[*] Talent Activated Animation: There is now visual feedback for when a creature’s talent is activated.
[*] Various Minor Visual Improvements (item usage arrow, buttons growing on mouseover, selection outlines, custom mouse cursor, new whistle and backpack visuals…)
[*] New Game Over screen
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/41a1f43b5d7360e51ea2a2a32c54e9bdf7ea5cf1.gif[/img]
[i]Talent names appear on a creature when it's activated[/i]

[h1]Items outside of battle[/h1]

Have you ever wanted to use syringes or heal your creatures [i]before[/i] a battle? Well, now you can!
We've finally added the ability to use items outside of battle! All you have to do is to open your inventory in the encounter choice menu, right before starting a battle :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/89f4f1c04eada2e0f745ab542cf057f402bab1b1.png[/img]
[i]The best moment to transfer a "When placed" talent is here...[/i]

[h1]New Creature[/h1]

We've added a new Danger Level 3 creature: the Tongue Biter! Although we didn't focus on new creatures in this update, we still wanted to include one new card for you to play with :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/44205ea48a32162f07cba756ee31a6ae8b24b169.png[/img]
[i]Very interesting morphology...[/i]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

We felt some creatures were overtuned compared to others, especially in the case of starters and their evolutions. We made some changes to bring them more in line with each other, and hopefully balance out their popularity. We remain attentive to the community’s feedback and opinions!

Swamp Beast (NERF)
[list]
[*] “Blood Surge” now gains 1 power regardless of amount healed.
[*] “Undying” now resurrects with half max HP (rounded up).
[/list]
Boulder Crab (NERF)
[list]
[*] Rocky Shell can only get triggered once per battle.
[/list]
Monomono (BUFF)
[list]
[*] “Defecate” is now limited use 2 instead of 1.
[/list]
Lily Goose (BUFF)
[list]
[*] “Herbfinder” is now limited use 2 instead of 1.
[/list]
Blood Grub (NERF)
[list]
[*] Maximum Health decreased from 5 to 4.
[/list]
Blood Angel (NERF)
[list]
[*] Maximum Health decreased from 6 to 5.
[*] Base Speed decreased from 12 to 10.
[/list]
Bull Weevil (NERF)
[list]
[*] Base Speed decreased from 4 to 3.
[/list]
Quetzi (NERF)
[list]
[*] “Poisoned Scales” is now limited use 1 instead of 2.
[/list]
Boss (BUFF)
[list]
[*] Abominations now inflict weakness when attacking.
[/list]
Scale Item (NERF)
[list]
[*] Now grants 1 sturdy instead of 2.
[/list]
Tyranorat (BUFF)
[list]
[*] “Chomp” is now limited use 5 instead of 3.
[*] “Rat King” now gives 5 atk+ instead of 3.
[/list]
False Yeti (NERF)
[list]
[*] “Group Roar” is now limited use 3.
[*] Maximum Health Decreased from 7 to 6.
[*] Base Speed decreased from 7 to 6.
[/list]
Bell Rat (REWORK)
[list]
[*] Base Speed increased from 3 to 4.
[/list]
Colossal Clawed Spider (NERF)
[list]
[*] Maximum Health decreased from 7 to 6.
[/list]
Quetzation (NERF)
[list]
[*] Maximum Health decreased from 9 to 7.
[/list]
Shell Cat (BUFF)
[list]
[*] “Guard” (+2 armor) replaced with “Hardening” (+3 armor).
[*] “Inkstain” now inflicts Sluggish for 3 turns instead of 1.
[/list]
Shell Panther (BUFF)
[list]
[*] “Trap Ink”  now inflicts Sluggish for 3 turns instead of 1.
[/list]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Well, that's it for today folks! Hopefully this update will make the game feel better to play, no doubt about that. In the meantime, we'll be working on new bosses (long overdue!) as we get closer and closer to the full release...
Until next time!

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.13
notes.content:
Welcome back to another episode of Decktamer Updates! This update is a little bit lighter but rest assured, we're still hard at work!

[h1]Legendary Cards[/h1]
This update introduces a new type of card: the [b]legendaries[/b]!
In addition to being more rare than usual, these creatures can only appear once in a run, so if you see one, it will be your only chance to get it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/28da800f8146e337239f939d52f2cd613284d114.png[/img]
[i]Legendary creatures have a different card layout featuring a fullscreen illustration![/i]

[h1]New creatures[/h1]
We've also added 6 new creatures with guest art made by [url=https://topdogentertainment.co/]TOP DOG Entertainment[/url] (thanks guys!). Naturally, these creatures all have their unique talents and moves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/360cefb459c431cb3b52770320bb3ec9e50f5e49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/36584d430ea683156830802aa94b2d0b46dd947d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/771aeab3be776982c834c879332535b8aa1d23d9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/3c31eb69ef59c368cda4fc192cfc178e8f3cb114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/ca68ad5daed694eb6afc76efed5d194ab9f305dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/358012de40b2bcfabccd7e541c9be2d635478786.png[/img]

[h1]Poison Change[/h1]
In order to make poison a little bit less frustrating to play against, it no longer bypasses armor.

[h1]Other miscellaneous changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The right click can now be used everywhere (not just for the creatures in battle)
[*] Keyword descriptions no longer go above the top of the screen
[*] The Hell Rat's talent has been buffed (+3 speed instead of +2)
[*] The Bell Rat has been tweaked (his talent only gives 1 armor now but he has 4 HP instead of 3)
[*] Silent One and Cognivil are now legendaries
[*] Other minor changes
[*] Further improvements to overall system stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.12
notes.content:
[b]A New Decktamer Update is on the Horizon![/b]
Get ready, Tamers! This update focuses on bringing more variety and strategic options to the early stages of your runs. Let's dive into what's new!

[h1]New Starters[/h1]
Previously, every starting deck was mostly the same: 5 Hell Rats paired with either a Lantern Dog or a Glowtongue. This setup worked fine for the demo, but as we approach the full release, it became clear that we needed to revamp the system. Well, that time has come!
At the beginning of your run, you'll now have the option to select a starter card along with a group of starter "rats" (for lack of a better term). The limited choices we had (Hell Rat, Glowtongue, and Lantern Dog) just weren't enough to provide meaningful variety. So naturally... we’ve added a bunch of new starter creatures for you to choose from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/0b757e6efe0bcd875f70b3c8221c21fff0c74adb.png[/img]
[i]Possible starters to choose from: Lantern Dog / Glowtongue / Quetzi / Lumi / Shell Cat / Furball / Blood Grub[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/905187b28d7cd917bd592aaceea9c091c83eefa5.png[/img]
[i]Possible group of allies to choose from: Hell Rat / Bell Rat / Bull Weevil[/i]

We hope this change makes each run feel a bit more unique and dynamic!
And on a related note... I wonder what would happen if a Golden Beetle were to bite one of these new creatures. 🤔

[h1]Poison Balance Changes[/h1]
We felt like poison was a little bit too annoying to fight against so we've decided to slightly rework it: Poison will now [b]decrease by 1 each turn[/b], similar to how it functions in other deckbuilders like Slay The Spire.
Additionally, a few creatures have received some minor balance changes

[h1]Creature Renaming[/h1]
You can now rename any of your creatures at any point in the run using the right click menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/45279808d3ec3bdfd1a5f46adefbe1cdbb06e5f3.png[/img]
[i]To rename, simply click the pen icon next to your creature's name.[/i]

[h1]Visual Changes[/h1]
We’ve made some visual enhancements to improve clarity during battles.

The armor effect is now displayed above the heart icon, making it easier to see how much protection your creatures have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/4ec5f30456e348f26211b8ab7b7bea4de62eb176.png[/img]

Additionally, the game will now notify you when your draw pile, discard pile, or spyglass is empty. We've also tweaked how situational effects (like the Lantern Dog’s Lantern Talent that inflicts Vulnerable) are displayed, making it easier to distinguish them from regular effects.
Finally, keyword descriptions no longer go under the bottom of the screen when reading a card in your hand.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
We hope you enjoy these new changes, it was quite a lot of work adding all of these new cards but we feel like it was worth the effort!

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.11
notes.content:
Welcome back for another Decktamer update!

This time, we aimed to tackle one of the game's most frequently mentioned critiques: there's not enough choices outside of battle! While Decktamer is certainly a complex game when it comes to battling, the gameplay that happens outside of battles could feel lackluster because the player didn't have a lot of agency over their run. You couldn't really choose what event to have, what enemy to fight or what reward to receive. Today, we're proud to announce a new system that aims to fix this.

[h1]Encounter Choices[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/fdda99aa797e3f1fe6da109ad40ee5ab10c74a1a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/ab5ed1701e95bb086d34de43818acc4ee7f5eb67.png[/img]

Before each battle, you'll now have the option to choose between two encounters. Each encounter presents a unique group of enemies to face, a set of rewards you'll earn upon victory, and a special event that unfolds in addition to the items. This system gives you more control over your journey, allowing you to influence which enemies you'll face (and potentially tame) and which rewards you'll collect. Need more berries? Pick the encounter with berry rewards! Looking for rare items? Opt for the encounter with valuable loot!

We believe this new feature will enhance the experience outside of battles and add more strategic depth to your overall run.

[h1]New Backgrounds[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/4c52cfed41bb546af7426fb498f24c5b242a16bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/1bcc02cda656d9e312e65ef3992212c551492cae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/e60caae3be10d7f262f29cb81542abfd65ed7a60.png[/img]

You might have noticed the backgrounds behind the encounter choice menu. Those are actually the new backgrounds you'll see in battle! We've redrawn them to be more immersive and overall better looking.
Eventually, we hope to add more biomes to further diversify the appearance of the game and also add particles and other visual effects to make them more dynamic.

[h1]Final Boss & Other Balance Changes[/h1]
The final boss was never meant to be permanent and will eventually get reworked more in depth, but in the meantime, we still wanted to have a fun and engaging battle. Previously, the boss was immune to all negative effects and while this made the boss powerful, it wasn't necessarily that fun to play against it since it shut down a lot of synergies (especially poison).
We've reworked its talent to only make it immune to Weakness (the Attack minus debuff) and to compensate for this nerf, we've made the boss's minions give it armor instead of health.

In addition to this, minor balance changes and other miscellaneous fixes were made to certain moves and talents.

[h1]New Creature[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/dfab22c80e1aba76d2b11ef56cff13e740c3ae7f.png[/img]
We also have a brand new creature in this update: the Phiopoda!
This is a tanky Danger Level 2 creature that plays around the Poison mechanic. The game doesn't have a lot of tanks so it felt like a good idea to include more :)

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
That's it for this update folks! We hope you'll enjoy the new Encounter Choice system and the other changes we made. In any case, let us know what you think on our Discord server!

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.10
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re back with yet another Decktamer Update. Here’s what’s new:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new creatures: Brown Marter, Hipponimus, Dipteranae, Gumursa and the Abyssal Great Elk
[*] Fixed a longstanding bug where effect icons were sometimes invisible when hovering an ability description
[*] Added the ability to remove cards from your deck in-between battles.
[*] Show Max HP when hovering a card
[*] Attack priority displayed on the attack animation (always hits first and always hits last)
[*] Damage Number changes color if dealing extra or lower damage (ex: damaging a vulnerable or sturdy creature)
[*] Removed the Dynamic Camera option since it wasn't popular nor needed
[*] Further improvements to overall stability, and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user's experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/dbca2d1a8d09c57548780bc09d5935cf7cff878d.png[/img]
[i]Bestiary photo of a Brown Marter[/i]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Now for what’s next: One common complaint about the game is the lack of player choice during a run (outside of battle). In the prototype phase of the game, we had a rough version of a Slay the Spire-like map system that we ultimately had to scrap due to various issues with our implementation. 

In any case, we have started to develop a new system that would let the player make more decisions on what battles to fight, which events to go to etc. It’s still early to talk about it in detail but we hope to have something interesting to show you in the coming weeks.

With that being said, thank you for your support and we hope you look forward to the next updates!

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.9.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have a new update for Decktamer!
This is a smaller update that focuses on UX improvements and things like visual effects on moves. Here’s a small list of all the changes:

[list]
[*] Buffed poison so that it can be stacked, meaning that a creature can take more than 1 damage from poison.
[*] Added 2 new creatures, the Spinehog (Danger Level 2) and Swamp Beast (Danger Level 4)
[*] Added the new Armor effect which acts as extra health (similar to games like Slay the Spire) and reworked some cards to use that effect
[*] Reworked a few cards like the Silver Hornet and most of the Danger Level 4 creatures. 
[*] User Experience changes and new Visual Effects for moves
[*] Buffed a few events such as the resting place for instance
[*] Further improvements to overall stability, and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user's experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.9
notes.content:
[h1]New Events![/h1]
Hello everyone! We're back with another update for Decktamer!
As announced in our last post, this update focuses on the game's events. Previously, we had only three events: the mushroom, the resting place, and the mutagen syringe. While these were fine, they lacked diversity and player choice, and we always knew we would need to expand on them eventually.
We're happy to announce that we've added 12 brand new events for you to discover! Additionally, we've restructured the game so that an event now occurs after each battle instead of every two battles.
On a related note, this significant change made the game easier, so to balance things out, we’ve enhanced the AI. The AI will now move its cards to the leftmost empty lane whenever possible, making it a bit smarter and more challenging.

[h1]Curses[/h1]
This update also introduces a new mechanic: curses. Curses are negative talents that cannot be removed and can be acquired in some events based on your choices. They add an element of risk to your rewards and make decisions more interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/29b4049ae6d191e083d2b6d636a233674cdccf82.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/535f7a4093d9246764c649677e1277a565cfbc48.png[/img]

[h1]Status Items[/h1]
Status items make their debut as well. These items have various effects and can be obtained through an event. They can be used as additional tools in battle and can definitely come in handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/27a4be7de99d966db13c27540938873d6d41492a.png[/img]

[h1]Creature Evolutions[/h1]
If you come across a Golden Beetle, beware of its mutagenic venom! If it bites one of your starting creatures, that creature will undergo a complete transformation and evolve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/6cdaec41b838dd659b02dc256cb512f4b239a814.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/c37226bf487944a72768fa0cfa6cc738213ce57b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/88b9290b4b19e63f13b9ae98f73cca1d6b2dbc6d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/651cf95219d9ef496889351684ff6cd239d910e0.png[/img]

[h1]And more…[/h1]
This is just a brief overview of the new events, as we want you to discover the rest on your own. In any case, we plan to add even more events in the future, so stay tuned!

That's it, folks! We hope you enjoy the update. If you have ideas for new events, let us know—we'd be happy to consider your suggestions. In the meantime, we hope you have fun discovering all the new events in Decktamer!

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone ! It's been a while, but we've been hard at work on Decktamer for the past weeks. Today, we're excited about the release of the biggest update yet!

Here's what's new:

[h1]New Difficulty System (Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/08189744ea709bf995743c9963bba11cc5e7349d.gif[/img]

We have heard you loud and clear, the game is either too difficult or even too easy for some of you so we’ve decided to introduce a brand new difficulty system. 
Each one of the 4 difficulties have different rules, for example:

- Your creatures will heal 2 HP after each battle in easy mode
- You can’t undo in Very Hard mode
- Herbs will only restore 1 HP in hard mode
- And more! (You can view the details for each difficulty by clicking the little [i] icon in-game)

At first, only the easy and normal modes are unlocked but you can unlock the others by beating the game in the previous difficulties. We hope you’ll enjoy the different challenges :)

[h1]Bestiary[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/56ab21faeee645379cedcce3fbdcf2cc707063b9.png[/img]
Ever wanted to know how each of the creatures in Decktamer lives in their natural habitat? Now you can!
The bestiary is a giant in-game encyclopedia of all the creatures of the abyss. It is written as you play, from the point of view of your character. At first, the bestiary is completely empty, but you can fill it by taming creatures while playing. What’s more, if you manage to beat the game while having a given creature in your deck, you can unlock a fun fact about it (and a little star that goes with it)! 

While we still intend on implementing other forms of meta progression, the bestiary is the primary form of unlockables in Decktamer so we hope you’re looking forward to that (we had a lot of fun writing each description).

[h1]New Creatures, moves and talents[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/bc4bea5941189b0184bf5496c78250d823902246.png[/img]
We’ve added 14 new cards, each with their own talents and moves (don’t know how many to be honest haha).
We’re really excited to see how you’ll use these new creatures in your deck and who knows, maybe you’ll find your new favorite here!
 
[h1]Major rework and balancing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/541a357bdebcfbb5da4adbea903eab179be1bcb8.png[/img]
We’ve changed a lot of the old cards you all know and love in order to balance the game. Whether it’s a buff, a nerf, a new ability or the removal of an old one every creature should feel better now and the balancing more consistent.

[h1]Right Click Menu[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922617/00a6d89a1de9e05c050dbd62cef0075a2abcb431.png[/img]
And last but not least, we’ve added a menu you can access by right clicking a card in battle. It’s mainly used to get a bigger, better view of the cards (and also see which mutations they have exactly). 
We still intend on adding minor features to this menu so stay tuned. 

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
That's it folks, we hope you'll enjoy the update! Until then, if you're looking for us, we'll be working on adding new events...

notes.title: Decktamer Demo Update 0.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Shortly after the demo launched, we gathered a lot of feedback and today, we're happy to announce the first update for Decktamer.

This update introduces the [b]Undo Button[/b]. After every turn, and before you do any action, you will get the opportunity to revert to the [b]end of the previous turn[/b] in case you made a mistake.
For now, the Undo Button can be used 2 times per battle but we're still experimenting with it to make it feel just right.
We hope that this feature will make the game more forgiving when players make small mistakes.

We also made small balance changes like making the mutation syringes no longer damage creatures (only when the syringe is full).

As always, we're still working on the balancing and we hope you look forward to new updates soon!

Full Changelog :

[list]
[*] Added Undo Button
[*] Added option to disable the dynamic camera (Disabled by default)
[*] Full Syringes no longer damage creatures
[*] Starting deck now includes a medicinal herb
[*] Users can now drag and drop the Whistle and the item cards in the inventory
[*] Further improvements to overall game stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience
[/list]
